app.title.description: Main app name displayed on the home screen.
app.title.notes: Do not translate the app name.

app.subtitle.description: Prompt below the title directing users to pick a game.

nav.back.notes: Keep short. The arrow ← may be kept or replaced with the locale's equivalent.

nav.backLabel.description: Accessibility label for the back button.

theme.label.description: Row label next to the theme mode selector.

theme.light.description: Theme toggle button text for switching to light mode.

theme.system.description: Segmented-control option that follows the OS light/dark preference.
theme.system.notes: Short — fits a compact 3-way segmented control alongside 'Light' and 'Dark'.

theme.dark.description: Theme toggle button text for switching to dark mode.

theme.switchTo.description: Accessibility label for the theme toggle. {{mode}} is 'light' or 'dark'.
theme.switchTo.notes: {{mode}} will already be translated by the time it is interpolated.

theme.lightShort.description: Short version of 'Light mode' for compact header buttons.

theme.darkShort.description: Short version of 'Dark mode' for compact header buttons.

lang.switcherLabel.description: Accessibility label for the language selector control.

settings.soundEffects.description: Label for the global sound effects toggle in Settings.

level.pill.description: Compact Arcade level badge in the Home header, e.g. 'Lv 4'. Abbreviate 'level' the way games in this language usually do.
level.pill.notes: Must stay very short — it sits in the header next to the title.

level.pillA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Arcade level badge in the Home header.

streak.pill.description: Compact daily-streak badge in the Home header next to the level pill: a fire emoji and the number of consecutive days, e.g. '🔥 5'.
streak.pill.notes: Keep the emoji and the {{count}} placeholder; it must stay tiny — it shares the header with the title and the level pill. Do not add words.

streak.pillA11y_one.description: Screen-reader label for the streak badge, singular form ({{count}} = 1): the number of consecutive days the player has hit their daily-challenge target.
streak.pillA11y_one.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian).

streak.pillA11y_other.description: Screen-reader label for the streak badge, plural form.
streak.pillA11y_other.notes: Plural forms follow the i18next count rules for the language (add every category the language has, e.g. few/many for Russian).

legal.privacyPolicy.description: Link label at the bottom of Settings that opens the Privacy Policy web page in the browser. Use the standard legal term for this document in the target language.
legal.privacyPolicy.notes: Two links share one row — keep it short.

legal.termsOfService.description: Link label at the bottom of Settings that opens the Terms of Service web page in the browser. Use the standard legal term for this document in the target language.
legal.termsOfService.notes: Two links share one row — keep it short.

a11y.loading.description: Screen-reader label for the loading spinner shown while a screen fetches data. Not shown visually.
a11y.loading.notes: Spoken by VoiceOver and TalkBack. Use the short progressive form, e.g. 'Loading'.
